title: cancelling a task cancels the spawned task only it awaits and waits for it
purpose: Accept the construct and observe its result.

stdout.text:
cancel requested
child settled
parent cleanup
-1

provenance.origin: authored for OCS 0.1.0; structured await by #147
provenance.expected_basis: The child is spawned by the parent and awaited only by it, so the parent's cancellation reaches the child; the parent resumes once the child's async cleanup has settled.
